name: Slot Reels
description: Text and figures that spin into their new value on staggered reels: each character rolls through its own class and lands with one small clunk.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. When it changes, characters that differ spin from the old value into the new one; the rest stay put.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between one spinning reel starting and the next. Reels that don't change aren't counted, so there are no gaps.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long one reel spins, in ms. Its width eases to the new character over the same time.

props.name: spins
props.description: Extra glyphs each reel passes, in sets of four. 0 rolls almost straight to the new character.

props.name: align
props.description: Where a shorter value is padded. auto pads figures on the left (so units stay put) and words on the right.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to spin every character again, even unchanged ones.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announce the value through a polite live region once the last reel lands. The full value is always in the accessible text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root. Type styles here set the reels' font, size and line height.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Called when the last reel has landed.
